articleTitle: Results of Investigation of Radio Interference in the Frequency Range 10 KHz to 150 KHz
publicationTitle: Prace Naukowe Instytutu Telekomunikacji i Akustyki Politechniki Wroclawskiej
abstract: The report presents the results of measurements of peak and quasi-peak values of RFI in the frequency range 10 kHz to 150 kHz produced by appliances incorporating electric motors, by luminaires with fluorescent lamps, by converters, welding equipment, RF ISM apparatus, high-voltage power lines and electric transport.

articleTitle: Broadening of Antenna Patterns Under Trans-Horizon Tropospheric Propagation and the Problem of Electromagnetic Compatibility
publicationTitle: Prace Naukowe Instytutu Telekomunikacji i Akustyki Politechniki Wroclawskiej
abstract: For determining an interfering signal level in the area of trans-horizon tropospheric propagation it is necessary to take into account patterns both of the receiving and the transmitting antennas. With narrow-beam antennas these patterns are broadening considerably due to scattering properties of atmospheric inhomogeneity.

articleTitle: On Mathematical Description of Some Sources of Man-Made RF Interference
publicationTitle: Prace Naukowe Instytutu Telekomunikacji i Akustyki Politechniki Wroclawskiej
abstract: This report proposes to regard, as a mathematical model of an RPI source, a response of some system to a specified effect, this system being described by a differential equation. In this case a system of distribution parameters, i.e. of mathematical expectations of coefficients of an equation and, if necessary, Of corresponding dispersions, can become a base for classification of sources of man-made RPI of imulsive type.

articleTitle: Evaluation of the Sensitivity of Quasi-Optimum Algorithm of Detection to the Change the Interference Situation
publicationTitle: Prace Naukowe Instytutu Telekomunikacji i Akustyki Politechniki Wroclawskiej
abstract: Practical realization of the optimum algorithms of detection of radiolocation signals in the presence of the narrow-band noise, according to the Neumann-Pearson criterion, is a very complicated task. This leads to the use of quasi-optimum algorithms which can be simply realized in practice. An algorithm which is realized in the simplest way among all kinds of optimum algorithms of detection for a given type of noise is called a quasi-optimum algorithm.

articleTitle: Measurement of Mutual Interference Between Systems with PSM Transmission of Colour TV Signals
publicationTitle: Prace Naukowe Instytutu Telekomunikacji i Akustyki Politechniki Wroclawskiej
abstract: Colour TV signals can be transmitted to any distance without error accumulation due to PSM. In such transmission mutual interference between the TV systems results in digital error and jitter increase. Digital errors appear at the TV channel output whether the signal in being transmitted or not. However, jitter appeares only when the signal is transmitted.

articleTitle: A Model of a Cumulative Process of Impulsive Interference, Formed as an Aggregate of Simpler Pulse Traies
publicationTitle: Prace Naukowe Instytutu Telekomunikacji i Akustyki Politechniki Wroclawskiej
abstract: A model of a cumulative process of interference is considered, which may be used in particular for description of an amplitude and time structure of processes of man-made RFI in cities.

articleTitle: Methods of Calculation of Protection Ratios in Discrete Communication Systems in the Presence of Radio Interference
publicationTitle: Prace Naukowe Instytutu Telekomunikacji i Akustyki Politechniki Wroclawskiej
abstract: The report suggests a new effective method of evaluation of error reception probability in discrete communication systems with different types of keying in the presence of radio interference.

articleTitle: Estimation of the Measuring Error of a Random Signal Mean Power as a Result of the Meter Limited Dynamics
publicationTitle: Prace Naukowe Instytutu Telekomunikacji i Akustyki Politechniki Wroclawskiej
abstract: The paper handles a problem of a additional measuring error of a random electric signals mean power, obserwed as a result of a limited dynamics of the meter electronic circuits. The circuit dynamics is represented by a difference between maximum and minimum instantaneous voltage levels of the measured signal, which are properly processed by the electronic circuits of the meter. Moreover, an analysis is carried out of an influence of a type of the probability density of instantaneous values of measured signals on this error magnitude. An example is given of determining error characteristics in cases of a signal of a normal, of a gamma type and of a ”square root" distribution. An example is also given of determining a proper measuring range of the power meter, when taking into account a type of distribution of instantaneous voltage values of the investigated signal and a dynamics of the meter electronic circuits for these instantaneous voltages.

articleTitle: An Analysis of Radio Interference Due to Rectifiers in Electronic Equipment
publicationTitle: Prace Naukowe Instytutu Telekomunikacji i Akustyki Politechniki Wroclawskiej
abstract: The paper deals with generation of radio interference due to a rectifier with its input capacitively coupled to the mains, energy being consumed in pulses. The process depends on the current-voltage characteristics end inertion properties of semiconductor diodes serving as current switch.

articleTitle: Increase of Efficiency of Frequency Channel Usage in Television Broadcasting
publicationTitle: Prace Naukowe Instytutu Telekomunikacji i Akustyki Politechniki Wroclawskiej
abstract: An increase of efficiency of frequency channel usage in the network contributes to electromagnetic compatibility improvement. Increase of efficiency can be achived in particular with protection ratio decrease /without reception quality impairment/, protection increase provided by receivers, and improvement of transmitting equipment characteristics. The introduction of precision offset mode effectively decreases co-channel interference. The development of low-price units, providing low-power station and repeater operation in this mode, will facilitate its wide introduction.

articleTitle: On the Selection of Those Parameters of Man-Made Interference, Which Determine its Disturbing Effect on the Equipment of Analog and Digital Transmission Systems
publicationTitle: Prace Naukowe Instytutu Telekomunikacji i Akustyki Politechniki Wroclawskiej
abstract: The report gives an analysis of stability of operation of typical channels of equipment of transmission systems when they are affected by impulsive interference. It is shown that the peak and quasi-peak values of interference do not give the necessary information about the conditions of operation of equipment of transmission systems. It is proposed to use the parameters of interference-pulse trains as parameters of electromagnetic r environment, which are to be specified by limits.

articleTitle: Some Problems of Immunity from Interference of F1 and F4 Systems in Maritime Radiocommunication
publicationTitle: Prace Naukowe Instytutu Telekomunikacji i Akustyki Politechniki Wroclawskiej
abstract: In order to discuss applications of facsimile in maritime radiocommunication for transmissions of information in analogue way to telex, it is necessary to draw a comparison of both systems in aspect of their practical utilization. Sufficient criterion of immunity from interference formulated for both studied systems may be a basis for carrying such a comparison.

articleTitle: Experimental Studies of Long-Distance Microwave Propagation due to Snow Coverage in the Mountains
publicationTitle: Prace Naukowe Instytutu Telekomunikacji i Akustyki Politechniki Wroclawskiej
abstract: Mountain crests and ridges covered with snow may cause long-distance microwave propagation due to wave refrection in a snow layer. In this case high signal levels at the distance up to 700 km considerably exceeding the level of tropospheric and diffraction fields can be observed. These phenomena should be taken into account in solving the problems of electromagnetic compatibility in mountain areas. The report gives the results of experiments on some paths with mountain obstacles covered with snow. Peculiarities of this type of radio wave propagation and statistical characteristics of the field are considered.

articleTitle: Electromagnetic Compatibility of Digital and Analogue Information Circuits in Cable Lines of Urban Telephone Networks
publicationTitle: Prace Naukowe Instytutu Telekomunikacji i Akustyki Politechniki Wroclawskiej
abstract: Electromagnetic compatibility of digital and analogue information circuits in cable lines of urban telephone networks is determined by the mutual influences between the circuits, the parameters of digital information signals and the tolerance values of interference in the adjacent cable circuits.

articleTitle: High Order Harmonics of Current in Electrical Networks Generated by Industrial Rectifiers
publicationTitle: Prace Naukowe Instytutu Telekomunikacji i Akustyki Politechniki Wroclawskiej
abstract: In chemical, metallurgical and other industries rectifiers with multiphase influence /for example 24, 36 or 48 phases/ on network are used. In the paper algorithm of the calculation of the high order harmonics of current in the network for the basic circuits of the rectifiers with the single or double way conections is given. The algorithm also enables an analysis of the influence of the asymmetrical reactances of the transformers and of certain failure conditions of the circuit on the genaration of the high order harmonics of this current.

articleTitle: The HF Radio Links Carier Frequency Interchange Investigations
publicationTitle: Prace Naukowe Instytutu Telekomunikacji i Akustyki Politechniki Wroclawskiej
abstract: The paper deals with the so-called frequency diversity problem in the HF radio links. It is assumed that the interference levels are measured at the receiving point on different frequencies end the best frequency is chosen and changed in transmitting point.

articleTitle: Out-of-Band Spectra of Emission of Single-Sideband Transmitters
publicationTitle: Prace Naukowe Instytutu Telekomunikacji i Akustyki Politechniki Wroclawskiej
abstract: The paper gives the results of studies on out-of-band spectra of emission of SSB and ISB transmitters on the basic of the proposed method of calculation of correlation function and signal power spectrum at the output of a non-linear radio circuit. This method is based on approximation of the transfer function up to a certain point Un by a polynomial of the k<sup>th</sup> degree which after the point Un transforms into a straight line without a break in the first derivative.

articleTitle: Some Questions of a Theory of Current Probes
publicationTitle: Prace Naukowe Instytutu Telekomunikacji i Akustyki Politechniki Wroclawskiej
abstract: In this report expressions are obtained for calculation of the value of inductance of the current-probe winding as well as of a coefficient of mutual induction between this winding and an interference-carrying conductor which is arbitrarily located relative to the current probe. The conditions are shown, under which the eccentricity of the interference-carrying conductor as well as a nearby neighbouring current-carrying conductor affect the results of measurements in the largest degree.

articleTitle: Suppression of RFI Generated by Thyristor Convertors
publicationTitle: Prace Naukowe Instytutu Telekomunikacji i Akustyki Politechniki Wroclawskiej
abstract: Values of interference /RFI/ from devices containing thyristors are much higher than permissible levels. Practical experience of interference suppression from high power thyristor devices has shown that to get good results, not only a mains filter is needed but one should design the device itself taking into account RFI suppression and to use its elements as suppression elements. The paper gives the general rules and principles of the design and construction of thyristor convertors from the point of view of interference lowering and shows examples of proper suppression. Special consideration to suppression characteristics of power transformers is given.

articleTitle: Analysis of Radiation Fields of Apertures with an Arbitrary form of their Contour
publicationTitle: Prace Naukowe Instytutu Telekomunikacji i Akustyki Politechniki Wroclawskiej
abstract: The report considers a fringe radiation of an aperture antenna with an arbitrary form of the aperture contour. It is shown that apart from the contribution of boundary waves which are formed by singular points of the contour, the formation of fringe radiation is strongly influenced by interaction of boundary current-waves excited on the surface of the mirror. The necessary and sufficient conditions for formation of a system of boundary waves are formulated. Reference problems of diffraction for determination of amplitudes of boundary waves are formulated. The applicability of these problems in case of determination of fringe radiation of a mirror antenna is analysed.

articleTitle: Use of Some Methods of Research of Frequency Planning Operations
publicationTitle: Prace Naukowe Instytutu Telekomunikacji i Akustyki Politechniki Wroclawskiej
abstract: Approach to the problems of optimal frequency allocation providing absence of harmful mutual interference for a radio link group is given. The mathematical model and algorithms described in the report are rather efficient under unfavourable conditions of electromagnetic compatibility and may be used as the basic for practical frequency planning in various types of radio services.

articleTitle: Influence of the First Local Oscillator Power Spectrum of the Communication Receiver on its Sensitivity and Workability at the Presence of Strong Interfering Signals
publicationTitle: Prace Naukowe Instytutu Telekomunikacji i Akustyki Politechniki Wroclawskiej
abstract: The interference caused by reciprocal mixing may be basic factor which deteriorates communication receiver sensitivity. In this paper the method of increasing of interference-immunity of a receiver is presented. It is achived by means of narrowband, tuned LC circuits which are connected into signal path of the first local oscillator. The new definition of receiver dynamic range which takes the reciprocal mixing into account, is proposed.

articleTitle: Characteristics of Cumulative Processes of Man-Made Interference for Various Scatterings of Interference Sources in Space
publicationTitle: Prace Naukowe Instytutu Telekomunikacji i Akustyki Politechniki Wroclawskiej
abstract: The report considers the following four main types of arrangement of man-made interference sources in space relative to a radio receiver: concentrated arrangement, linear scattering, plane scattering, bulk scattering.

articleTitle: Interference Recognition from the View Point of Nonparametric Statistics
publicationTitle: Prace Naukowe Instytutu Telekomunikacji i Akustyki Politechniki Wroclawskiej
abstract: A problem is considered of development of an interference discriminator to provide the normal operation of radio receivers equipped with noise-proof means in a rather complex electromagnetic situation. Some nonparametric approaches are suggested to distinguish complex hypothesis. Concrete algorithms are given of pulse and continuous noise recognition on the background of Gaussian noise.

articleTitle: Application of a Directional Coupler for Measurement of Power of Spurious Oscillations in a Screened Two-Wire Transmission Line
publicationTitle: Prace Naukowe Instytutu Telekomunikacji i Akustyki Politechniki Wroclawskiej
abstract: Conditions are obtained, which ensure a possibility of directional coupling of total power of inphase and antiphase oscillations in a screened two-wire transmission line. It is shown that these conditions are satisfied by a device consisting of two coaxial directional couplers whose primary lines form a two-wire transmission line.

articleTitle: Radio Interference from ISM Apparatus and Establishing their Limits
publicationTitle: Prace Naukowe Instytutu Telekomunikacji i Akustyki Politechniki Wroclawskiej
abstract: The report gives a brief characteristic of ISM apparatus as radio interference sources (their significance, peculiarities, possibilities of interference suppression etc). The ways and possibilities are estimated of the effect of RFI from ISM apparatus on radio receivers through the main receiving channels and through spurious channels. The permissible RFI levels are determined from the point of view of protection of radio broadcasting and television reception, of radio communication with mobile objects, and of air radio navigation, with various quality and reliability of radio reception.

articleTitle: Methods of Improvement of Radiometer Noise Immunity
publicationTitle: Prace Naukowe Instytutu Telekomunikacji i Akustyki Politechniki Wroclawskiej
abstract: Methods are considered of improvement of the modulation radiometer noise immunity /limitation, strobing, detection of the smallest values/ and the correlation radiometer /frequency-shifted compensation/ under the condition of influence of external random pulse and periodic interference. The principle possibility of the potential sensitivity increase of the modulation radiometer is shown when receiving nonstationary noise signals.

articleTitle: Assessment of Clicks in Case of Restricted Volume of Measurements
publicationTitle: Prace Naukowe Instytutu Telekomunikacji i Akustyki Politechniki Wroclawskiej
abstract: Possibility is shown of utilisation of binomial distribution and of reliability theory based on this distribution for assessment of clicks. The report gives expressions and examples of design of permissible number of exceeding a specified level taking into account the error introduced by measuring equipment and the prescribed values of the producer's and consumer's risks. The obtained results enable to make the Volume of measurements several times smaller with retaining the acceptable Values of the producer's and consumer's risks.

articleTitle: Analysis of EMC with Mobile Land Radio Communication Facilities in a City
publicationTitle: Prace Naukowe Instytutu Telekomunikacji i Akustyki Politechniki Wroclawskiej
abstract: The report gives the main points of an algorithm of an analysis of EMC of mobile land radio communication facilities with television and USW FM broadcasting facilities, as well cub with other mobile radio communication facilities. A principle is given of approximation of actual characteristics of radio facilities, (which determine the EMC), with a view to obtaining the design equations. Methods for obtaining the parameters of equations are quoted. For a number of types of radio facilities in question the equations and numerical values of their parameters are given. Main proposals are set forth for improvement of EMC between the radio facilities of a city.

articleTitle: Methods of Evaluation of EMC for Group of Electrical Apparatus
publicationTitle: Prace Naukowe Instytutu Telekomunikacji i Akustyki Politechniki Wroclawskiej
abstract: Parameters of EMC may be determined analytically and by modelling. Analytical decision consists of parameters of EMC found by probable characteristics of electrical loads of apparatus. Theory of probability formulae for functional transformation of the random values systems and correlation theory are in use. Dose of flicker during fatigues time of visual analyser depends on voltage and parameters changes of flickermeter filter. With the increasing number n of apparatus of the same type, dose of flicker is increasing proportionally to <tex>$\sqrt{n}$</tex>. Modelling of voltage and devices processes changings are allowed to receive the most objective evaluation of EMC.

articleTitle: Some Results of HF Spectrum Occupancy Investigations
publicationTitle: Prace Naukowe Instytutu Telekomunikacji i Akustyki Politechniki Wroclawskiej
abstract: This paper decsribes conditions and results of the spectrum loading investigations in the high-frequency band /4-5 MHz/. HF noise as a function of frequency and time of day was measured in Warsaw suburban region during the last year in order to find diurnal and annual noise power distribution. The results have been compared with the analogous observations obtained in Great Britain. USSR and USA.

articleTitle: Forecast Calculation Methods of Interference Range Due to VHF and UHF TV Waves Scattering from Overhead Power Transmission Lines
publicationTitle: Prace Naukowe Instytutu Telekomunikacji i Akustyki Politechniki Wroclawskiej
abstract: Television broadcasting waves are sometimes scattered by the construction of large power transmission lines, and ghost images and screening interference are consequently generated at receiving points. This paper discusses calculation methods for forecasting the range of ghost image interference caused by conductors and pylons of power transmission lines. Furthermore, actual examples of calculation by these methods are provided.

articleTitle: Current Harmonics Spectra on D.C. Lines Supplying Inverter - FED Induction Motors Drives
publicationTitle: Prace Naukowe Instytutu Telekomunikacji i Akustyki Politechniki Wroclawskiej
abstract: The argument which is taken in exam concerns some aspects of the inverter fed induction motor drives operation which may cause EMC problems. In particular the current on the D.C. line supplying the inverter stage is analysed; that is depending on the harmonies presence that the inverter's static commutations introduce in form of equivalent current sources connected in series to the main D.C. line. The consequent possible EMC problems are briefly described and the different elements which affect the current harmonics production are discussed. An operating way is identified which should allow to obtain indications about the effects, under the mentioned point of view, of any kind of induction motors, driven through an inverting stage corresponding to one of the main technical solutions. Because of space problems, only a particular motor is taken in exam, for which a series of numerical results were elaborated, and some experimental tests were carried out for a square wave controlled inverter. Some final considerations are deduced about the obtained results and the prospective necessary work.

articleTitle: A Hypothesis of Plasmonic Absorption of RF Energy by Biological Objects
publicationTitle: Prace Naukowe Instytutu Telekomunikacji i Akustyki Politechniki Wroclawskiej

articleTitle: Activities of CCITT Study Group V in the Field of Electromagnetic Compatibility
publicationTitle: Prace Naukowe Instytutu Telekomunikacji i Akustyki Politechniki Wroclawskiej
abstract: The paper explains the terms of reference of CCITT Study Group V "Protection against danger and disturbances of electromagnetic origin". It summarizes the state so far reached and documented by CCITT in this field and mentions the most important publications, such as Directives, handbooks and recommendations. The working program allocated to Study Group V by the VIth Plenary Assembly of CCITT is indicated. Reference is made to necessary future activities of Study Group V in the field of elctromagnetic compatibility.

articleTitle: Calculation of Distance Range in Radiotelephone Networks Working with Intermittent Transmission
publicationTitle: Prace Naukowe Instytutu Telekomunikacji i Akustyki Politechniki Wroclawskiej
abstract: A communication distance range in land mobile radiotelephone networks is limited either by internal noise of receivers or by interference produced by co-channel and adjacent-channel undesirable signals. The intermittent operation of transmitters reduces the total influence of the interference in comparison with the continuous transmission. Consequently the communication distance range increases. A dependence of distance range on traffic parameters is shown and a suitable methods of calculation are described.

articleTitle: Relationship Between the Amplitude Probability Distribution of the Quasi-Peak Composite Manmade Noise and the Values Measured with the CISPR Interference Meter
publicationTitle: Prace Naukowe Instytutu Telekomunikacji i Akustyki Politechniki Wroclawskiej
abstract: Formulae are derived which allow the evaluation of the amplitude probability distribution APD of the composite man-made noise on the basis of measurements conducted with the ordinary CISPE interference meter. The only condition is that one must measure pairs of values, namely continuous background noise and short bursts. Results obtained are discussed and conclusions drawn.

articleTitle: Polarization Effects on the Detection of Obstacles in the EM Similarity Conditions
publicationTitle: Prace Naukowe Instytutu Telekomunikacji i Akustyki Politechniki Wroclawskiej
abstract: The evaluation of a radar cross section (RCS) in modelling conditions depends upon the polarization used. In some cases the real operation of the "radar" equipment occurs for close distances, within the near field range and also the tests for designing purposes are carried out at a different but still near field distance. In an example a quantitative comparison of RCSs and of scintillations between vertical and horizontal polarizations of the wave input is reported.

articleTitle: Computer-Aided Spectrum Management
publicationTitle: Prace Naukowe Instytutu Telekomunikacji i Akustyki Politechniki Wroclawskiej
abstract: Both the public and the private sectors of the Canadian broadcasting system generate demands for frequency spectrum as they implement their coverage plans - designed to give the Canadian public a wide range of program services. The CBC's Mandate is to provide radio and television services in two official languages across the country. It is the major single user of availably frequency spectrum. Optimum spectrum utilization is achieved through a computer-aided frequency search and coordination process.

articleTitle: TEM Cell - An EMC Testing Tool
publicationTitle: Prace Naukowe Instytutu Telekomunikacji i Akustyki Politechniki Wroclawskiej
abstract: The paper presents some factors limiting the accuracy of standard electric and magnetic fields generated in TEM cell. The influence of asymmetry of a symmetric strip line upon its input impedance has been considered. Calculating results of cell mismatch increase due to the introduction of an electric field probe to the cell have been presented. The relation of voltage determination accuracy between the cell walls in relation to the cell matching in conditions of measuring power fed to the cell in three ways has been analysed. The value of changes in the antenna reactance of electric and magnetic field probes due to their placement between the cell walls as well as the resulting from that an apparent increase of sensitivity of those probes have been calculated and measured.

articleTitle: Noises Within Extremely Low Frequencies
publicationTitle: Prace Naukowe Instytutu Telekomunikacji i Akustyki Politechniki Wroclawskiej
abstract: For the industrial regions, the man-made interferences within extremely low frequencies, visibly dominate the atmospheric and ionospheric disturbances reaching sometimes such a high level that it makes impossible to carry out conventional geophysical measurements. In the paper the results of measurements of horizontal and vertical components of electric field interferences in the regions which are far from power lines and devices, are presented. The measurement were carried out within frequences from 50 - 1000 Hz in a system as presented on the fig.1. The spectrum components were measured by means of a selective meter, the noise curve being recorded on a recorder in order to be submitted to farther analysis by means of a computer. In the fig. 2 tipical noise spectrum of vertical /full line/ and horizontal components /broken line/ of an electric field are presented. In the fig.3 the results of measurements of a rare case in which the levels of even harmonics exceeds the levels of uneven harmonics are presented. In comparison with noises appearing at harmonic frequencies of the net, the noises appearing with remaining frequencies are neglegible. The level of nises changes slowly but the man-made impuls interferences were not observed. The measurements were carried out in winter and spring time, i.e. in a period in which the atmospheric interferences may be neglected.

articleTitle: Research into the Electromagnetic Disturbances Caused by Lightning in Buildings
publicationTitle: Prace Naukowe Instytutu Telekomunikacji i Akustyki Politechniki Wroclawskiej
abstract: One can calculate the magnetic field when the distribution of the lightning current in lightning conductors and their connecting wires is known. Because of the over all complexity one cannot work out a purely mathematical result of the distribution of current. But by using a model technique the distribution of lightning current is determinable in a purely measuring procedure. The following tests were carried out: 1) Effects on lightning current distribution from the amount of down conductors and connecting wires. 2) Determination of location of the down conductor with the maximum current. 3) Effects on the current distribution due to the mesh-size. The measured results are presented and discussed.

articleTitle: Comparison of the Results of Simplified Analysis to the Measurements of Ground-Wave Field Strength
publicationTitle: Prace Naukowe Instytutu Telekomunikacji i Akustyki Politechniki Wroclawskiej
abstract: The simplified analysis of ground-wave propagation, outlined by Prof. Wojnar and by this author at the Third Wrocław Symposium on EMC III, facilitates the rapid assessment of median field strength in the 24-200 MHz frequency band. The estimates obtained from simplified formulas are here compared to the results of exact computer calculations and to experimental data published by various authors. Satisfactory agreement in the basic zone implies the correctness of first-order estimates /of median field strength/ resulting from simple, approximate formulas.

articleTitle: On the Measurement of Hazardous E.M. Fields Radiated Through an Aperture
publicationTitle: Prace Naukowe Instytutu Telekomunikacji i Akustyki Politechniki Wroclawskiej
abstract: The measurement accuracy in the evaluation of hazardous conditions created by e.m. fields radiated through apertures in a metallic plane is analyzed. The study is first referred to the use of magnetic probes in the frequency range from 10 to 300 MHz and the to the use of broad-band lossy electric field probes from 0.3 to 18 GHz.

articleTitle: RF Radiation Hazard on SEA-Going Ships
publicationTitle: Prace Naukowe Instytutu Telekomunikacji i Akustyki Politechniki Wroclawskiej
abstract: On board new-built merchant, fish, passenger and research vessels an increasing number and power of installed radio transmitters and radars producting a high frequency electromagnetic field can be observed. Investigations into such physical quantities as field strength and microwave power density are conducted for many years by Centrum Techniki Okrętowej - Ship Design and Research Centre - in Gdańsk, Poland in the aspect of biologically harmful effects upon the ship's crew'é body in case the admissible value of the field strength would have been exceed. Electromagnetic field strength measurements are taken within a frequency range of 150 kHz to 300 MHz whereas microwave power density measurements are carried out in the S - band within 2 900 - 3 300 MHz and in X - band within 9 300 - 9 500 MHz.

articleTitle: Remarks on HF Magnetic Field Standards
publicationTitle: Prace Naukowe Instytutu Telekomunikacji i Akustyki Politechniki Wroclawskiej
abstract: This paper describes two methods of generating the standard magnetic field: the method of standard field based on the measurement of power fed to an antenna and the method of standard magnetic field generation by using TEM transmission cell. Comparison of these two methods from efficiency point of view is discussed.

articleTitle: Calculation of Mutual Inductance of Multiwire Shields
publicationTitle: Prace Naukowe Instytutu Telekomunikacji i Akustyki Politechniki Wroclawskiej
abstract: Interference on shielded cables can be produced by an external electromagnetic field, that penetrates through holes, cracks etc. into the interior of the shielded cable. The transfer impedance is an important characteristic quantity of shielding efficiency. In the high frequency range the transfer impedance is determined by the mutual inductance, describing magnetic field penetration through holes, cracks and gaps in the shield. A method is demonstrated to calculate mutual inductance on multiwire shields. The calculation takes into consideration the proximity effect between shield wires with circular cylindrical geometry. Supposing skin effect at high frequency the surface current density is described by means of a Fourier expansion. Then the mutual inductance is determined by means of the vector potential on the conductor surface. The dependence of mutual inductance from the shield design parameters is discussed.

articleTitle: On Internal Compatibility in Radio-Communication Networks
publicationTitle: Prace Naukowe Instytutu Telekomunikacji i Akustyki Politechniki Wroclawskiej
abstract: The radio-network compatibility is usually analysed in terms of the environmental interference affecting the system performance. However, with increasing network complexity the intrasystem interference tends to predominate. Here, the internal compatibility in radio networks is tentatively defined and studied. For the VHF/UHF systems, the spatial configuration and spectral assignments are analyzed. Novel algorithmic design rules are illustrated with a numerical example of a land mobile system. General conclusions are formulated.

articleTitle: Recent Progress of EMC Studies in Japan
publicationTitle: Prace Naukowe Instytutu Telekomunikacji i Akustyki Politechniki Wroclawskiej
abstract: Recently, Electrical Environment Problems have been closed up in Japan. The problems Include EMI or Radio Noise, TV ghost image problems, malfunctions of electronic systems, biological effects of EM fields, optimum electrical energy usages in social systems and so on. It is said that these must be treated as EMC problems. Because of these back grounds, special technical group of EMC (G-EMCJ) has been established in IECE of Japan and IEE of Japan last year, having the purposes to promote the EMC studies and to give the stage for discussions on the problems mentioned above.

articleTitle: Methodology for the Spotting and Investigation of Principal Radio Interference Sources in D.C. Electric Rolling Stock Units
publicationTitle: Prace Naukowe Instytutu Telekomunikacji i Akustyki Politechniki Wroclawskiej
abstract: The report is describing procedures of spotting the principal sources of iterference in d.c. tractive stock, while quoting the findings of investigations carried out to this effect in equipment operated in 3 kV d.c. with respectively classical and thyristor controls. The features specific of the principal noise sources in this type of equipment have also been described.

articleTitle: Some Aspects of EMC in Multiprogram TV Retranslation Stations
publicationTitle: Prace Naukowe Instytutu Telekomunikacji i Akustyki Politechniki Wroclawskiej
abstract: Factors deciding on proper functioning of a TV retranslation station are delineated. Basic parameters of devices from the point of view of interfering their inputs by signals from adjacent channels are discussed and appropriate methods of testing are proposed. Influence of the Interaction among programs emitted is taken into account. The attention is drawn on the possibility of generation of interfering signals in the passive networks. This phenomenon leads to limitations in the retranslation network planning.

articleTitle: Some Remarks on ARC Discharges at the Guy Insulators of the MF and LF Broadcast Tower Antennas
publicationTitle: Prace Naukowe Instytutu Telekomunikacji i Akustyki Politechniki Wroclawskiej
abstract: Results of measurements of physical properties of arc in 1-20 MHz frequency range, its resistance and a condition of lasting are given. The reason of arising of arc discharges at the guy insulators of vertical antennas are presented.

articleTitle: Instrument for the Classification of Fast Mains Voltage Variations
publicationTitle: Prace Naukowe Instytutu Telekomunikacji i Akustyki Politechniki Wroclawskiej
abstract: The instrument, described in this paper, was developed to record fast mains voltage variations (minimum duration 10 ms approximately) in order both to define susceptibility tests for data processing equipment (EPE) and to have a portable set capable of analyzing the mains network before installing a DPE. The instrument, whose operation is controlled by a microprocessor, classifies the mains voltage amplitude by means of eight threshold levels, preset at different voltage values, which sample the maximum of each mains voltage half-wave. Every time mains voltage variations fall within the preset threshold range the corresponding half-wave number is counted. At the output a data-printer records the threshold levels involved, the half-cycle number totalized for each level and the time at which the variations occur.

articleTitle: A Quality Analysis of URH Radiotelephone Network Design by EMC Characteristics
publicationTitle: Prace Naukowe Instytutu Telekomunikacji i Akustyki Politechniki Wroclawskiej
abstract: The aim is to introduce a theory suitable for determining the complex design quality of a land mobile VHF/UHF radiotelephone, network from an electromagnetic compatibility point of view. The quality examination was based on the traffic-, frequency band utilization-, interference immunity - and coverage characteristics of the networks. For this purpose so called EMC factors have been worked out which can be given in a numerical form. From these factors a so called resultant complex EMC factor has been obtained which will characterize the design quality factor of the networks by a numerical value.

articleTitle: Electric and Magnetic Field Sensors (Design and Calibration)
publicationTitle: Prace Naukowe Instytutu Telekomunikacji i Akustyki Politechniki Wroclawskiej
abstract: Electric and magnetic field sensors have been designed both in directional and isotropic configuration for radiation hazard measurements. The design and optimization of both electric and magnetic field sensors are presented with particular attention paid to the calibration problems which represent the most critical area in the development of these types of sensors.

articleTitle: For More Efficent Utilization of the Sixth Natural Resource
publicationTitle: Prace Naukowe Instytutu Telekomunikacji i Akustyki Politechniki Wroclawskiej
abstract: The purpose of this paper is to present some general aspects of the modern philosophy of spectrum utilization. The problem of increasing spectrum pollution is extensively discussed, and several examples of the most important sources of spectrum pollution are given, shoving its influence on the quality of communications. Attention is drawn lo the urgent need for improving the efficiency of spectrum utilization, in view of the increasing demand for new channels in existing services and for new services, and the need to improve the quality of communications. Several examples of radiocommunication systems are cited, where such possibilities exist, for instance: sound and TV broadcasting, land mobile services, etc. The importance of inter-organizational co-operation between such organizations as CISPE, IEC, CCIR and CIGRE is discussed and the role of international meetings such as symposia on Electromagnetic Compatibility in the improvement of understanding of problems of the effective radio-spectrum utilization is pointed out.

articleTitle: Nonlinearities in the Instruments for Measurements in the Frequency Domain and their Impact on the Results Obtained
publicationTitle: Prace Naukowe Instytutu Telekomunikacji i Akustyki Politechniki Wroclawskiej
abstract: Problems are stated which arise in the measurements of discrete spectra. Factors are described which limit the possibility of using the whole dynamic range given by producers in the information sheets of instruments. The results of two-signal test, which defines the reel dynamic range for some uses of the instrument, are shown and discussed. Conclusions are drawn and a proposal made to elaborate special tests, the results of which should be introduced into information about the instruments.

articleTitle: Electromagnetic Compatibility, from the Pragmatic to the Scientific Approach
publicationTitle: Prace Naukowe Instytutu Telekomunikacji i Akustyki Politechniki Wroclawskiej
abstract: In 1953 the director of the Philips Research Laboratories, mr. Rinia, asked me to take the place of my retired colleague or, Weyers, as a Dutch representative at CISPR meetings, and to add radio interference problems to my other duties. I did not like the prospect of working on this subject at the time, because I was prejudiced in thinking it was a very pragmatic subject in which a certain versatility in the use of screens and earth leads counted more than theory. It was only much later, that I realised the importance of electromagnetic compatibility and its wide spread of interesting and difficult questions in all directions.
